# Real log lines, copied verbatim out of the live Elasticsearch index on 2026-09-07, plus the
# handful of shapes that exist in production but happened not to be in the sample window (a POST to
# /api/vote, a 404, a 5xx). Format: <expected-pattern>[ field=value,...]<TAB><the line>
#
# These are the INPUT THAT MUST MATCH. CLAUDE.md's rule is that a check which can never match is
# found only by feeding it something you know should match, once -- this file is that "once", kept
# runnable. Do not thin it out and do not paraphrase the lines: the trailing "$http_x_forwarded_for"
# field, the "-" placeholders and the exact quoting are all things the nginx pattern depends on.
#
# --- nginx: `combined` + the trailing "$http_x_forwarded_for" ------------------------------------

nginx http_path=/style.css,http_status=200,client_ip=89.138.2.64	10.0.28.30 - - [06/Sep/2026:17:00:55 +0000] "GET /style.css HTTP/1.1" 200 32870 "https://voteball.latnook.com/" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:154.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/154.0" "89.138.2.64"
nginx http_path=/fonts/heebo-latin-var.woff2,http_status=200	10.0.28.30 - - [06/Sep/2026:17:00:55 +0000] "GET /fonts/heebo-latin-var.woff2 HTTP/1.1" 200 30116 "https://voteball.latnook.com/style.css" "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:154.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/154.0" "89.138.2.64"
# The query string must land in http_query, NOT in http_path: /api/results?by=all and ?by=club are
# one endpoint, and folding the query into the path scatters it across a bucket per parameter.
nginx http_path=/api/results,http_query=by=all,http_status=200	10.0.28.30 - - [06/Sep/2026:17:00:55 +0000] "GET /api/results?by=all HTTP/1.1" 200 900 "-" "curl/8.0" "1.2.3.4"
nginx http_method=POST,http_path=/api/vote,http_status=201	10.0.28.30 - - [06/Sep/2026:17:00:55 +0000] "POST /api/vote HTTP/1.1" 201 45 "https://voteball.latnook.com/" "Mozilla/5.0" "1.2.3.4"
nginx http_status=404,http_path=/nope	10.0.28.30 - - [06/Sep/2026:17:00:55 +0000] "GET /nope HTTP/1.1" 404 153 "-" "-" "-"
# A 5xx is the single most important line the dashboard exists to surface. If the pattern ever stops
# matching this one, the "top 5xx endpoints" panel goes empty and reads exactly like "no errors".
nginx http_status=500,http_path=/api/vote	10.0.28.30 - - [06/Sep/2026:17:00:55 +0000] "POST /api/vote HTTP/1.1" 500 27 "-" "Mozilla/5.0" "1.2.3.4"
# An HTTP/2 request and one with no x-forwarded-for field at all -- both legal against this ALB.

# --- the synthetic canary's own line -------------------------------------------------------------
canary http_status=200,http_method=GET,http_path=/	200 GET /

canary http_status=503,http_path=/api/vote	503 POST /api/vote
